items.title: FindConfig
items.description:
An object that is used to configure how an entity is retrieved from the database. It accepts as a typed parameter an `Entity` class,
which provides correct typing of field names in its properties.

items.title: BaseFilterable
items.description: An object used to allow specifying flexible queries with and/or conditions.

items.title: SoftDeleteReturn
items.description: An object that is used to specify an entity's related entities that should be soft-deleted when the main entity is soft-deleted.

items.title: RestoreReturn
items.description: An object that is used to specify an entity's related entities that should be restored when the main entity is restored.

items.title: CampaignBudgetUsageDTO
items.description:
Record of promotion usage as part of a campaign whose budget type
is `use_by_attribute` or `spend_by_attribute`.

items.title: CampaignBudgetExceededAction
items.description:
This action indicates that the promotions within a campaign can no longer be used
as the campaign budget has been exceeded.

items.title: PromotionLimitExceededAction
items.description: This action indicates that a promotion usage limit has been exceeded.

items.title: AddItemAdjustmentAction
items.description: This action indicates that an adjustment must be made to an item. For example, removing $5 off its amount.

items.title: RemoveItemAdjustmentAction
items.description: This action indicates that an adjustment must be removed from a line item. For example, remove the $5 discount applied before.

items.title: AddShippingMethodAdjustment
items.description: This action indicates that an adjustment must be made on a shipping method. For example, make the shipping method free.

items.title: RemoveShippingMethodAdjustment
items.description: This action indicates that an adjustment must be removed from a shipping method. For example, remove the free shipping discount applied before.
